payload.name: Directional claim verification for multi-person questions
payload.description: When a question names two people and a directional action (A watched/recommended/suggested X to B) and the top result reverses the direction or covers only one person, verify before answering.
content: When a question names two people and a directional action (A watched/recommended/suggested/gave X to B), a retrieved memory that reverses the direction or involves only one person is insufficient; do not answer from it.

Run a follow-up search for each named person using their name plus action terms (e.g., watched, recommended, suggested, gave) without requiring the question's date, since the supporting memory may be dated differently.

Before answering, verify the candidate memory supports the claimed actor, action, and recipient; if not, keep searching until one memory covers all claims or separate per-person searches have been exhausted.
Stop as soon as a memory covers all claims in the question; do not retrieve additional unrelated events.

solves: Questions that ask what one person watched, recommended, suggested, or gave to another on a specific date are sometimes answered from a partial or direction-reversed memory that merely shares a date or keyword. This skill ensures the agent verifies actor-action-recipient alignment and runs per-person follow-up searches before committing to an answer.
